grid: ground diamond 32 x 16 px; a block is 16 px tall; sizes and anchors are at 1x (multiply for 2x and 3x)
placement: a cell (col, row) at height h (px) has its back corner at screen x = X0 + 16 (col - row), y = Y0 + 8 (col + row) - h; draw a sprite at (x - anchor[0], y - anchor[1])
draw_order: cells by col + row, front cells last; on one cell: blocks bottom to top, then overlays, then the object; a bigger object counts as its front cell
footprint: cells along col (U, to the lower right) and row (V, to the lower left)
height: where the piece stands or its top is, in px above the cell base: blocks 16, half blocks 8, liquids 12, floors 0; ramps and stairs give [from, to]
up: ramps and stairs climb towards that screen corner: ne (towards row - 1), se (col + 1), sw (row + 1), nw (col - 1)
corners: paths: N = 1 (back corner), E = 2 (right), S = 4 (front), W = 8 (left); a corner is road when the map vertex there is road
joins: fences, walls and hedges: NE = 1 (row - 1), SE = 2 (col + 1), SW = 4 (row + 1), NW = 8 (col - 1)
frames: animations are named _f1.._f4; suggested 6 fps (water, foam, waterfalls), 4 fps lava, 8 fps fire
shadows: solid shadow sprites with the same anchor as their object; draw them under the object at about 35% opacity
